title: Participation Packet Requirements by Activity Type, Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
The participation packet each activity type of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** requires for the school year is fixed by the figures below: the forms that must be on file, whether a pre-participation physical examination is required and for which grades, the earliest exam date that counts, the grades that need the UIL steroid acknowledgment, the district random drug testing consent and the preseason parent meeting.

## Forms on file for the school year

| Activity type | Required forms |
|---|---|
| Campus Club Membership | parent permission, code of conduct |
| UIL Academic and Robotics Team | parent permission, code of conduct, overnight travel permission |
| Middle School UIL Athletics | medical history, concussion acknowledgment, sudden cardiac arrest awareness, parent permission, code of conduct |
| Fine Arts Performing Ensemble | parent permission, code of conduct, overnight travel permission |
| High School UIL Athletics | medical history, concussion acknowledgment, sudden cardiac arrest awareness, parent permission, code of conduct, steroid acknowledgment |
| Cheer and Dance Team | medical history, concussion acknowledgment, sudden cardiac arrest awareness, parent permission, code of conduct |
| Grade 5 Outdoor Education Trip | parent permission, medical history, overnight travel permission |

## Physical examination, steroid acknowledgment, drug testing consent and parent meeting

| Activity type | Physical examination required | Grades needing a new physical for the school year | Grades needing the UIL steroid acknowledgment | Random drug testing consent among the required forms | Parent attends the preseason meeting before clearance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Campus Club Membership | no | none | none | no | no |
| UIL Academic and Robotics Team | no | none | none | no | no |
| Middle School UIL Athletics | yes | 07 | none | no | yes |
| Fine Arts Performing Ensemble | no | none | none | no | no |
| High School UIL Athletics | yes | 09, 11 | 09, 10, 11, 12 | yes | yes |
| Cheer and Dance Team | yes | 07, 09, 11 | none | no | yes |
| Grade 5 Outdoor Education Trip | no | none | none | no | no |

**Earliest exam date.** For every type, the earliest exam date that counts for the school year is May 1 of the calendar year the school year starts. Grades not listed for a new physical need only the annual medical history form.

## Points of reading

- A Grade 10 High School UIL Athletics student needs the steroid acknowledgment and the drug testing consent but, grade 10 not being a physical grade, no new physical for the school year.
- For a school year starting in a hypothetical year Y, an exam dated April 30 of year Y does not count and one dated May 1 of year Y does.
